subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery ladder, and if so which recovery actions are allowed by default versus explicit opt-in?
rationale: The request adds new core recovery semantics, config surface, operator notifications, and potential security-boundary changes that cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep as a design umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to drive a maintainer-approved core design, then review narrower PRs such as the watchdog service, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash ladder against that design.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical issues
options.body: Close this only after each remaining slice is moved to a specific open canonical issue with the broad context linked there.

options.title: Reject core ownership
options.body: Declare that recovery should stay in external supervisor/plugin/ClawHub tooling and document the supported external pattern instead of adding core watchdog semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep as a design umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to drive a maintainer-approved core design, then review narrower PRs such as the watchdog service, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash ladder against that design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Gateway health, restart, docs, and current-main restoration of the relevant code paths.
